parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly states an action: "the authors should also compare their results with those of pretrained models." This is a direct instruction. Moreover, the comment provides concrete details: the model class to compare against (pretrained ViT models), the task domain (remote sensing), and an evaluation condition (even without fine-tuning in the RS domain). Given this explicit pointer to pretrained ViT models and remote sensing tasks, the authors can readily implement the action by evaluating pretrained ViTs on the same RS tasks and comparing results. Therefore, the action is explicit and concretely specified, fitting the rubric description for an explicit action with concrete implementation details.
